## Product Question

> Which skills, locations, and role variants give an early-career candidate the strongest entry into Business Intelligence / Data Analyst roles in U.S. depository banking (NAICS 5221), and which skills are missing from a current student profile?

## Why This Industry

Depository credit intermediation (NAICS 5221) is one of the largest non-technology employers of analytics talent in the United States: retail and commercial banks run continuous reporting, credit risk, fraud, and regulatory analytics functions that are staffed by business intelligence and data analyst roles rather than by research scientists. Because banking analytics is shaped by regulatory reporting and legacy data warehouses, its skill profile differs from the software sector — SQL, data governance, and domain knowledge often outweigh machine-learning depth. That contrast makes 5221 a well-defined scope for a product that advises a job seeker on where to apply and what to learn next.
